NARRATIVE AND PLANS
TYPE I Rezoning Attachment
2201-03 West Cermak Road / 2200-08 South Leavitt Street
From B3-2 to B2-5
The Property
The subject property is a vacant parcel located in a B3-2 Community Shopping District.

It is located in an Equitable Transit Served Location approximately 1,270 feet from the Damen Pink Line CTA
station entrance.

The Project
PINK LINE LLC, a Delaware limited liability company (the “Applicant”) proposes to build a five story residential

building (49’-6” height) with 18 units and 4 indoor parking spaces. 22 bicycle spaces will be provided.

The Applicant seeks to rezone the property from a B3-2 Community Shopping District to a B2-5 Neighborhood
Mixed-Use District.

The Applicant also is seeking all relief as needed, as allowed by the Chicago Zoning Code, through a Type-1
application under section 17-13-0300(D) as follows: 1) an optional variation under section 17-13-1101-A for
relief under section 17-13-1003-EE(1) to allow an decrease in parking for properties in a Transit Served Location
to a qualifying train station from 9 required parking spaces (50%) under section 17-3-0308 to 4 spaces and 2) an
optional variation under section 17-13-1101-B to reduce the required 30’ rear yard setback required under section
17-3-0405-A to zero.

The following are the relevant zoning parameters for the proposed project:

Lot Area: 5,000 square feet

Maximum FAR: 4.0

Floor Area: 20,000 square feet

Residential Dwelling Units: 18

MLA Density: 277.7 square feet

Height: 49°-6”

Bicycle Parking: 22

Automobile Parking: 4*

Setbacks: Front (north/Cermak): zero
East (Leavitt): 0.03”
West: zero

Rear (south/alley): zero*

A set of plans is attached.
* The Applicant seeks optional variation relief under section 17-13-0300(D).
